title: Describing Automated Processes
grammar: Describing Automated Processes in Modern Hungarian
goal: I can analyze automated data processing, neural tokenization, and vector embeddings (*szóbeágyazás, tokenizálás, neurális hálózatok*).
I can describe automated processes the way modern Hungarian does (*a modell feldolgozza, az adatokat tárolják, vektorrá alakul*), without a passive.
I can characterize the mechanization of linguistic communication in high-register prose.
